title: XRD-guided learning identifies Li₆AsSe₅I as a room-temperature superionic conductor
summary: XRDMatch, a semi-supervised model using X-ray diffraction patterns as its descriptor, screened unlabeled crystal data and identified 38 lithium superionic-conductor predictions. The paper says 32 were supported by prior literature, six were new candidates assessed with ab initio molecular dynamics, and Li₆AsSe₅I was synthesized and experimentally confirmed as a superionic conductor. The source abstract does not establish that all 38 are new or experimentally validated; this record covers the single reported synthesized material.
organization: East China Normal University; Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Westlake University; Microsoft Research Asia; collaborators

evidence.tested: XRDMatch, a semi-supervised model using X-ray diffraction patterns as its descriptor, screened unlabeled crystal data and identified 38 lithium superionic-conductor predictions.
evidence.unknown: The publisher abstract says six newly predicted candidates were quantified with ab initio molecular dynamics, but names only Li₆AsSe₅I as synthesized and experimentally confirmed. It reports 32 additional predictions matched recent literature. The full publisher article was inaccessible during the source review (HTTP 403); the annotation is limited to the primary publisher abstract and its article metadata.
evidence.ai_role: Consistency regularization and pseudo-labeling let the model learn from limited labeled conductivity data and unlabeled ICSD X-ray diffraction patterns. It nominated Li₆AsSe₅I for synthesis, where the researchers experimentally confirmed superionic conductivity.
